g.text: Terms: DoD = US Department of Defense · GCS = ground control station · GPS = Global Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · IF-nnn =
interface in the item definition (architecture/item-definition.yaml) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD
Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SCC = software control category
(MIL-STD-882E Table IV) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SSF-nnn = safety-significant software function record (safety/software/) · SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1
= dockable observation UAV · SwCI = software criticality index (MIL-STD-882E Table V) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
